summaries.text:
This resolution congratulates the Jewish War Veterans of the United States on the 129th anniversary of its founding and recognizes the organization for its dedication to the welfare of veterans, the Jewish community, and the nation.

The resolution also affirms the importance of the Jewish War Veterans’ ongoing work in ensuring the sacrifices of veterans and lessons of history are never forgotten.

title: Congratulating the Jewish War Veterans on the 129th anniversary of the organization's founding and honoring their commitment to Jewish war veterans.
